card.name: Inside long drug and medical words
card.fires_on: Partway through long drug names and medical terms, on a middle piece such as 'ang' in rearrangements, 'ax' in desvenlafaxine, or 'chlor' in hydrochloride. It also fires on a few stray spots such as a blank space before a section number.

modes.label: Middle of drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand or generic drug name that is split into several parts.
modes.example: desvenlaf<<ax>>ine who present with progressive dyspnea

modes.label: Middle of medical terms
modes.description: A middle piece of a long clinical or label heading word.

modes.label: Stray function spots
modes.description: Occasional small words or spaces such as 'this' or 'new' before a noun.
modes.example: while taking<< this>> drug, fluvastatin capsules should
